nodes.text: Establish whether the following are true assuming the generalised continuum hypothesis:\[\omega_3 \to (\omega_2,\omega_1+2)^2,\]\[\omega_3\to (\omega_2+\omega_1,\omega_2+\omega)^2,\]\[\omega_2\to (\omega_1^{\omega+2}+2, \omega_1+2)^2.\]Establish whether the following is consistent with the generalised continuum hypothesis:\[\omega_2\to (\omega_1+\omega)_2^2,\]or even $\omega_2 \to (\xi)_2^2$ for all $\xi<\omega_2$.

#1172 : [ErHa74,p.272] [Va99,7.87] set theory | ramsey theory A problem of Erdős and Hajnal. The Erdős-Rado partition theorem [ErRa56] states that\[(2^{\kappa})^+ \to (\kappa^++1)_\kappa^2\]for every infinite cardinal $\kappa$.
